hooks.command: mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/ts-eslint-proxy.mjs" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ts-eslint-proxy.mjs" && chmod +x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ts-eslint-proxy.mjs" && if ! lsof -ti :7475 > /dev/null 2>&1; then mkdir -p "${HOME}/.claude/logs" && ESLINT_IDE_PORT=7475 node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/eslint-aggregator.mjs" >> "${HOME}/.claude/logs/eslint-aggregator.log" 2>&1 & fi
